title: Bastian reads the amyloid biopsy (paraphrase C)
topic: A clinic studies amyloid deposits in a patient's biopsy: Bastian finds deposits of misfolded amyloid in dense plaques, the laboratory finds a tau protein, a scan reveals more plaques, the patient's daughter asks questions, Bastian explains the misfolding and gives the family a treatment plan

E.pred: passes the family the treatment plan

tail_E: The patient mixes up names and is gradually losing his
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'memory' completes 'the patient mixes up names and is gradually losing his' after ten units about amyloid deposits, plaques, a tau protein and a scan. The word and its German equivalents (Gedächtnis / Erinnerung) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and no symptom is named inside the units, so the prediction rests on the tail plus the clinical context. ' memory' is a single Pythia token (id 3541); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.41, next candidate 'ability' ~ 0.02; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F20 (amyloid biopsy in the clinic, Bastian)
notes: Formulation C, domain protein_misfolding: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F20A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Bastian). Replacements include examines a biopsy/analyses a biopsy (untersucht/analysiert), shows amyloid deposits/contains amyloid deposits (zeigt/enthält), consist of misfolded amyloid/are misfolded amyloid (bestehen aus/sind), finds a tau protein/detects a tau protein (findet/entdeckt), requests a scan for the next morning/orders a scan for the morning after (veranlasst/bestellt), reveals more plaques/documents further plaques (enthüllt/dokumentiert), asks many questions in the corridor/has many questions in the passage (stellt viele Fragen auf dem Flur/hat viele Fragen im Gang), explains the protein's misfolding with a drawing/describes the protein's misfolding with a diagram (erklärt/beschreibt, Zeichnung/Diagramm), discusses the treatment options that afternoon/considers the treatment options that same afternoon (bespricht/erwägt), gives the family the treatment plan/passes the family the treatment plan (gibt/reicht). Domain vocabulary is kept in both languages: Amyloid, Ablagerungen, Plaques, Fehlfaltung, fehlgefaltet, Tauprotein; the compounds are written closed ('Amyloidablagerungen', 'Tauprotein') because lsne.lang_id splits hyphenated words and would read a stray 'Protein' as English. As in F20A/B, unit 8 avoids a segment-final bare German 'Protein' by using the genitive 'die Fehlfaltung des Proteins'. 'analysiert', 'enthält', 'entdeckt', 'bestellt', 'dokumentiert', 'beschreibt' and 'erwägt' are inseparable; no separable verbs ('nachweisen', 'anordnen', 'aufzeigen', 'abwägen', 'aushändigen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English. 'Bastian' is labelled 'N' by lsne.lang_id (not in the lexicon's name list), which costs no accuracy.
